name: qkd_ectl_slot-q13r3-4800fafd7
purpose: q13-ectl: the Qwen3-8B ROM TP8 die cell qkd_ectl (32 slots, contract qwen_rom_tp8 v3: 648 x 129.6, M5 cap, pins e0-e3 / s0-s3 / t0 / t1 on S / N, rq / rs on W, si / so on E) as a hardened slot-shaped view: wrapper qkd_ectl over ot_qwen_nearhbm_ectl_h (DQ 128, two-level SRAM row / e FIFOs) built with KVD_ECTL_SLOT. Replaces the old-interface qkd_ectl_b view (531.36 x 345.6, t_c / t_row / t_e); variants c / f at this width never closed (c -519 / -28.7 ps TT, f +19.39 TT / -1.78 FF at 172.8 high, clock insertion ~500 ps). r3 submission (owner clock rule: <= 15,000 sinks per root passes on count), kit recipe 2, TritonCTS (a declared spine measured worse, 615.9..653.6 ps, and was reverted): 14,806 sinks on ONE root over 648 um, measured pre-route TritonCTS TT insertion 357..538.1 ps (324 um half-span from the single N entry) -- insertion to be budgeted by the die lead. If this route fails hold / setup at the seam, the next form is the cluster of three ~216 um hardened sub-tiles with their own N clock entries (slot change: three ck entries) and rows FIFO flop level 4 -> 2.

structural_change: TP8 slot cell: score-return pin stage + mid relay, row-word relay, er pin stages, FIFO flop level 8 -> 4, DQ128 SRAM, M5 cap, recipe 2. TP8 slot structure (KVD_ECTL_SLOT) instead of the variant c / f frame: score returns get a pin stage at the s pins and a mid relay before the E-face score register (+2 cycles, tags delayed alike), the 1,025-b row word gets W-face pin flops plus a relay in front of the row FIFO, er_valid / er_addr / er_data get E-face pin flops (push delayed by 2), the flop level of both two-level FIFOs goes 8 -> 4 rows (clock root under 15,000 sinks), five SRAM macros in one row with 5.4 um halo and the M5 pin-edge guard, every pin at its exact contract track with its flop FIRM at the pin, M5 cap
